summary: MDJM LTD filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of its independent registered public accounting firm RBSM LLP, effective May 21, 2026, and the engagement of Tang Qian Associates, PLLC as its new auditor, effective May 22, 2026. The change was approved by the Audit Committee and was not due to any disagreements or reportable events in prior fiscal years. RBSM's previous reports were unqualified. The filing includes RBSM's letter agreeing with the statements. This auditor switch is a management/oversight change but lacks the abrupt/forced departure typical of a special situation; the filing is a routine change of accountant.Form 6-K is the equivalent of an 8-K for foreign private issuers. What to watch: any subsequent disclosure of internal control issues or material weaknesses.
